snapshots.morning: 08:00 America/Los_Angeles on the board date; games tipping at or before it are excluded
snapshots.close: last observation at or before tip minus 10 minutes, same book, same side

features.base_pool: most recent 30 same-team played games (minutes > 0), this season and last, before the board date
features.matched_pool: most recent 30 same-team played games matching every rotation teammate: out => teammate under 10 min; active => 10+ min
features.rotation: median minutes >= 24 over the teammate's last 15 games played for this team
features.rate: (matched stat + 200 * rate_base) / (matched minutes + 200); games under 8 minutes excluded from rates and alpha
features.minutes: E[M], Var(M) (n-1) from this season's matched games (minutes > 0, short appearances included) if >= 3, else last season's
features.distribution: negative binomial with Var = E[mu] + alpha E[mu^2] + Var(mu) + estimation (Var(rate_final) from the matched sample under the model, Var(M)/n); Poisson when Var <= mean
features.teammates: on this team now and seen in its box scores this season (DNP rows count) or listed tonight; last season stands in before a team's first game

shrink_fit: conditional log loss over decisive outcomes, over side, all evaluated train props, report availability; golden section on [0,1]
blend_w: logit p = w logit(raw model conditional) + (1-w) logit(no-vig), half-point props with both sides at the same book; log loss
missing_data: a prop with one side missing, stale, or unmatched is dropped from both log-loss scores and counted
selected rows without a same-book same-line close are excluded from CLV and counted; line moves reported separately
zero minutes voids; players absent from the box score are not graded
injury: latest official report printed >= 30 minutes before the snapshot; a team not yet submitted uses the previous evening's entries for tonight, otherwise its players are unsupported
clv: morning decimal / closing decimal - 1, same book, side and line

demonstrated_edge_requires: report-availability replay: lower bound of w interval > 0
report-availability replay: lower bound of selected-row CLV interval > 0
report-availability replay: >= MIN_CLV_GAMES unique games with a same-line close
gate.oracle: printed as an upper bound; never sufficient
gate.delta_ll: printed with the DLL_MARGIN; not gating
gate.post_hoc: a rerun after a code fix is labeled post-hoc and cannot earn demonstrated edge

dispersion_fit: per stat, (1 - q) NB(mean, mean + kappa (var - mean)) + q short night; q on a 0.01 grid, kappa by golden section; mean log score on train box scores (scripts/fit-dispersion.ts)
